topic: Moser's Circle Problem: The Deceptive Pattern
target_audience: High school students or introductory discrete math students

sections.title: Introduction & The Problem Setup
lecture_lines: Place n points on a circle's edge.
Connect every pair with straight chords.
We create slices like a pizza.
How many regions for n points?
animations: 1. Display circle with 1 point. [Color: #FFFFFF] Label point 'P1' and region 'R1'.
2. Draw chord between two points; highlight two resulting regions. [Color: #FFFF00]
3. Connect three points to form a triangle; highlight the four regions. [Color: #00FFFF]
4. Connect four points with all possible chords, showing eight regions. [Color: #FF00FF]
5. Animate transition between n=1, 2, 3, 4 cases side-by-side. [Color: #FFFFFF]

sections.title: Data Collection & Pattern Hunting
animations: 1. Display n=1, 2, 3 circles with region counts 1, 2, 4. [Color: #FFFFFF]
2. Animate growth for n=4, 5 reaching 8 and 16 regions. [Color: #FFFF00]
3. Display the sequence 1, 2, 4, 8, 16. [Color: #00FF00]
4. Present the formula R = 2^(n-1) below the sequence. [Color: #00FFFF]
5. Highlight the formula with a box for emphasis. [Color: #FFFF00]

sections.title: The Trap & The Critical Thinking Shift
animations: 1. Predict 32 regions for n=6 based on 2^(n-1). [Color: #FF0000]
2. Draw the 6-point configuration with all chords. [Color: #FFFFFF]
3. Count the regions carefully, pausing at 31. [Color: #FFFF00]
4. Cross out the 2^(n-1) formula in red. [Color: #FF0000]
5. Display 'Pattern Broken!' text next to n=6. [Color: #FFFFFF]

sections.title: The Combinatorial Solution
lecture_lines: Plus n choose two, plus one.
animations: 1. Present new formula: R = nC4 + nC2 + 1. [Color: #FFFFFF]
2. Animate (nC4) term growing as intersection points appear. [Color: #00FFFF]
3. Animate (nC2) term growing as chords are drawn. [Color: #FFFF00]

sections.title: Conclusion & Takeaway
animations: 1. Place 'Guess' (2^(n-1)) and 'Truth' (nC4 + nC2 + 1) in adjacent columns. [Color: #FF0000, #00FF00]
2. Highlight the Truth formula correctly predicting n=6 count. [Color: #00FF00]
3. Fade in 'Question Everything' text in center. [Color: #FFFFFF]
